mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO evaluation_result ( region_code, region_name, management_capability_score, support_capability_score, self_rescue_capability_score, comprehensive_capability_score, management_capability_level, support_capability_level, self_rescue_capability_level, comprehensive_capability_level, evaluation_model_id, data_source, execution_record_id, org_code, create_by ) VALUES
( #{item.regionCode}, #{item.regionName}, #{item.managementCapabilityScore}, #{item.supportCapabilityScore}, #{item.selfRescueCapabilityScore}, #{item.comprehensiveCapabilityScore}, #{item.managementCapabilityLevel}, #{item.supportCapabilityLevel}, #{item.selfRescueCapabilityLevel}, #{item.comprehensiveCapabilityLevel}, #{item.evaluationModelId}, #{item.dataSource}, #{item.executionRecordId}, #{item.orgCode}, #{item.createBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT er.id, er.region_code, er.region_name, er.management_capability_score, er.support_capability_score, er.self_rescue_capability_score, er.comprehensive_capability_score, er.management_capability_level, er.support_capability_level, er.self_rescue_capability_level, er.comprehensive_capability_level, er.evaluation_model_id, er.data_source, er.execution_record_id, er.org_code, er.create_by, er.create_time, er.update_by, er.update_time, er.is_deleted FROM evaluation_result er INNER JOIN model_execution_record mer ON er.execution_record_id = mer.id WHERE er.evaluation_model_id = #{modelId} AND mer.year = #{year} AND er.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY er.create_time DESC

SELECT er.id, er.region_code, er.region_name, er.management_capability_score, er.support_capability_score, er.self_rescue_capability_score, er.comprehensive_capability_score, er.management_capability_level, er.support_capability_level, er.self_rescue_capability_level, er.comprehensive_capability_level, er.evaluation_model_id, er.data_source, er.execution_record_id, er.org_code, er.create_by, er.create_time, er.update_by, er.update_time, er.is_deleted FROM evaluation_result er INNER JOIN model_execution_record mer ON er.execution_record_id = mer.id WHERE er.evaluation_model_id = #{modelId} AND mer.year = #{year} AND ( (mer.org_code IS NOT NULL AND mer.org_code = #{orgCode}) OR (er.org_code IS NOT NULL AND er.org_code = #{orgCode}) OR (er.region_code IS NOT NULL AND er.region_code LIKE CONCAT(#{orgCode}, '%')) ) AND er.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY er.create_time DESC
